ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the surface is dominated by low-intensity dark pixels with minimal high-intensity variance across the primary fluke body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity black region across the entire surface area; localized high-contrast (white/cream) geometric clusters are mapped exclusively to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 135-degree obtuse V-shaped central notch with a shallow vertical depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities across the medial edges; high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness at the distal tips coinciding with localized surface anomalies.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the leading edges transitioning to a moderately tapered, slightly concave sweep toward the distal tips along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast white pixel clusters forming dense circular and semi-circular groupings at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) providing heavy texture and high-contrast marking on the distal margins; scattered minor white punctate marks across the central-right lobe.
